title: FairPrice bid package
description: A procurement's bill of quantities (BoQ) and every bidder's price schedule. xlsx and csv packages, with the column headings of a PPRA (Kenya) price schedule, are read into this shape and checked against it; a package that does not match is refused, never interpreted.

boq.description: The procuring entity's bill of quantities: what is being bought.

line.description: Line number, unique in the BoQ. Bids are matched to the BoQ by it.

item.description: What is being bought, as the agent should search for it.

unit.description: Unit of issue, e.g. No, SM, LM, Set.

budget.description: The procuring entity's budget per unit, if it sets one. The report shows each quote against it.

documents.description: The committee's checklist of the documents the tender requires: one entry per document, with what each bidder submitted.

ref.description: The document's reference in the tender, unique.

document.description: What is required, e.g. Tax compliance certificate.

rule.description: Submitted, Valid on YYYY-MM-DD, or Covers YYYY-YYYY.

bidders.description: For every bidder: Yes or No (Submitted); the date the document is valid until, or No (Valid on); the years it covers, or No (Covers).

bidder.description: The bidder's name, unique in the package.

line.description: A line number from the BoQ.

item.description: The bidder's own description, if any.

unit.description: Unit of issue, as the bidder wrote it.

total.description: Line total as written in the bid, if stated.

country_of_origin.description: Where the goods are made, if the price schedule asks.
